subject: Long legged shrimp
topic: Two and a half kilometers down, a shrimp stands on legs far longer than its body.
script:
Two and a half kilometers down, a shrimp stands on legs far longer than its body.
It's a long-legged shrimp, sometimes called a spider shrimp.
Those super long legs work like stilts.
They hold it up above the soft mud, so it doesn't sink in.
And they spread out its weight, like snowshoes for the seafloor.
This one was spotted near a chain of undersea volcanoes in the Mariana Islands.
It tried to swim, paddling up into the water.
With legs like these, swimming looks a little awkward.
Would you rather have super long legs or super long arms?
pkg_title: This Deep-Sea Shrimp Walks on STILTS 🦐 #Shorts
